done_when: An FDE can follow the guides to the first Promote without finding a contradictory rule, a promise of an unbuilt feature, a placeholder address or a missing production step.
why: A first-time FDE gets stuck because the guides say Claude runs the sign-off review, but the canvas check in that same sign-off always runs on Codex. They give three different plan-read rules, promise a sign-off step that is only a plan so far, show a platform address placeholder, and have no production checklist, role definitions or path for a client's cloud or servers.
